AC3 · AC4

Name is a <th scope="row">; total spend and spend limit are <td>s tied to <th scope="col"> headers — a screen reader announces "Total spend, Dining Out: $310.00 ⚠ Over limit" as one distinct, labelled field including the warning condition.

AC6 · AC7 · AC8

No-limit rows show muted "No limit set" text, never a number. Over-limit rows get a left accent bar, a tinted background, and a "⚠ Over limit" badge — icon + color + text label together, so the state still reads in grayscale or to a colorblind user.
